iti13:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti13:2.1: makkhaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
iti13:2.2: makkhañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā’ti.
iti13:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
